traits.name: Detect Life.
traits.text: The banshee can magically sense the presence of living creatures within 30 ft. that aren't undead or constructs.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement.
traits.text: The banshee can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Unusual Nature.
traits.text: The banshee doesn't require food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Corrupting Touch.
actions.text: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Wail (Recharges 5-6).
actions.text: All creatures within 30 ft. must make a DC 13 WIS save or drop to 0 HP. On success, takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
